supersedes.reason: V1 C0 inherited identity-bearing historical query/gallery loaders while declaring zero target-label reads. Its E0 and one-query C0 smoke are archived engineering probes only and are not eligible formal evidence.

purpose: A minimal, fail-closed representation qualification. It asks only whether frozen raw V verification tokens contain target-free candidate-conditioned signal for a natural exact query/reference versus current strongest-C128-competitor pair. It is not a target hypothesis, H0, ownership, candidate-recall, SWITCH/HOLD, or end-to-end retrieval experiment.

does_not_reuse_as_model_input: M0 G0 synthetic correspondence density-ratio calibration
M0 homography H1 slots or legality
M0 full-token likelihood marginal or MDL penalty
P embedding, P confidence, proposal seed, geometry, or coordinates
A0/C6 selector, ownership readout, D1 score, rank, slot, winner, or base gap
lineage_boundary.interpretation: A pass establishes only a frozen-V natural hard-negative representation increment and authorizes a separately frozen P-to-hypothesis comparison. A failure establishes only that this all-patch frozen-V form lacks qualified natural conditional signal; it does not falsify reference-conditioned latent hypotheses in general.

source_isolation.runtime_rule: C0 and target-free heldout scoring may read only the V2 sanitized query ledger, its token/path/grid/hash interface, the frozen full gallery and the assigned D1 checkpoint. They must not call historical load_query_rows, load_query_tokens, load_gallery, preflight_for_fold, or any target-bearing target-row construction.
source_isolation.query_ledger: The separate compiler derives query path/grid/shard metadata and a fixed heldout_fold solely from target-free atlas query IDs and non-target manifest fields. It serializes no identity, reference_label, target label, group or supergroup.
source_isolation.gallery_rule: Full-gallery exact labels are allowed only as intrinsic reference metadata needed to collapse duplicate physical rows. No query target is available at C0 or score time.
source_isolation.postjoin_boundary: A target-bearing runner may be used only after immutable C0 contexts (for loss-only train target join) or immutable heldout score vectors (for offline evaluation).

data_roles.population: The existing 987 natural query records and full 5,413 physical-row / 5,404 exact-label gallery are internal development data. Five folds are identity- and supergroup-disjoint internal OOF only, not a paper-confirmatory endpoint.
data_roles.candidate_context: For each outer fold, the assigned frozen D1 checkpoint is replayed over every one of the 987 natural queries with all 5,413 physical rows legal. Exact-label reduction occurs before C128. The prejoin artifact stores only 128 winning physical rows in a query-hash permutation plus non-model-facing score/reduction/mapping hashes; it stores no target, D1 numerical value, D1 rank, slot or winner.
data_roles.training_join: Only after immutable prejoin materialization may training join a train query's exact identity to choose its naturally present positive candidate for the loss. Its competitor is the current detached strongest non-target C128 candidate, not a frozen D1-ranked rival.
data_roles.evaluation_join: Only after immutable target-free scores for all 128 candidates may the evaluator join a target identity and replay D1 to identify the deployed D1 winner for offline metrics.
forbidden: human target masks, boxes, points, polygons, crops, or objectness teacher
oracle candidate insertion, C128-width change, target-specific parameter, or identity classifier
opened resources, sealed resources, or home-file modification

frozen_representation.pair_feature: For every query patch and candidate reference, use L2-normalized all-reference-token log-mean-exp support for visual/glyph/line, visual/glyph concentration and query textness. The same six-dimensional frozen local feature is applied to every candidate; no top-k, candidate-specific threshold, geometry, mask or patch selection is permitted.
frozen_representation.score: A single shared 6-to-8-to-1 head maps each patch feature to signed evidence. Output bias is absent because it cancels from the sole pairwise margin loss. The head has 64 active scalars. Candidate evidence is the exact uniform mean over all 1,024 query patches; the head has no candidate identity/order, label, D1, P, coordinate or rival input.

objective.primary: For every legal training query whose true exact label is naturally in C128, score all C128 candidates before reading its target, choose the detached strongest non-target candidate from current L0 scores, and minimize softplus(-(E_y-E_c_star)/1.0). This is the only retrieval-training objective.
prohibited: full-gallery or candidate-listwise cross entropy as a primary objective
D1/base fusion, D1-correct preservation loss, SWITCH/HOLD training
H0/no-match loss before a confirmed-absent versus present-nonprimary data contract exists
top-k, pooling, temperature, competitor, threshold or loss scan on outer-heldout outcomes

training_schedule.episode_order: deterministic hash shuffle of eligible fold-local train query IDs; repeat cyclically only if fewer than 768 eligible episodes

E0.objective: Validate only the exact all-patch V scorer, V2 sanitized source ledger and access boundaries. Do not train on a natural identity or score a heldout target.
required: 64 shared trainable scalars, all finite and nonzero-gradient on a synthetic fixture
one optimizer step changes parameters and reduces the registered fixture pair loss
candidate reorder equivariance and pair-swap antisymmetry
candidate-binding rotation changes attachment while pure reorder only permutes it
forward API has no target, label, rank, slot, winner, P, coordinate or geometry input
sanitized query ledger has exactly 987 records, fixed fivefold roles, no target-bearing schema key, and source hashes
gallery loader has 5,413 rows / 5,404 labels and no target-row construction
C0 prejoin and score receipt schemas are exact whitelists

C0.objective: Materialize and independently validate fold-local, all-query, full-gallery target-free C128 contexts before any natural label join or natural training.
required: 987 contexts per fold; 5,413 all-true physical gallery rows and 5,404 exact labels before C128 reduction
unique C128 exact labels and physical rows; hash-permutation independent of original D1 order
exact current fold checkpoint hash; full physical score hash; exact-label reduction hash; ordered physical-row-to-gallery-label mapping hash
independent replay validator recomputes D1 full scores, exact-label reduction, hashes and hash-permuted rows for every context
exact whitelist prejoin receipt, no target/D1 score/rank/slot/winner serialization and no target-bearing source-loader call
candidate rows resolve to frozen raw V base or a separately validated append-only V-only supplement
C0.throughput_gate: Before full 5x987 materialization, run one fixed C0+independent-validator episode and record wall time for each phase. Segment counts may be chosen only from that receipt; a 30-minute allocation is a wall-clock bound, not a claim that C0 is complete.

L0.target_free_forward: Fit the shared head on fold-local training identities after loss-only target join. For each heldout query, emit all 128 candidate scores before target/D1 join. Heldout forward has no labels, D1 numerical values, rank/slot/winner, P, coordinates or raw-query-image feature input.
L0.primary_slice: Outer-heldout records on which deployed D1 is wrong and the true exact target is naturally in independently materialized D1 C128. This slice is defined only after score emission.
required_reports: eligible train/heldout coverage by fold, identity, supergroup and track
per-fold train loss, active-gradient receipt and target-free score hashes
primary target-versus-deployed-D1-winner direction and signed margin
secondary all-target-in-C128 and D1-correct strata separately
candidate-binding rotation control only after model freeze
strict statement that L0 makes no spatial, ownership, H0 or retrieval-action claim
go: primary strict target-over-deployed-winner direction exceeds 0.50 with one-sided exact binomial p < 0.05
at least four of five fold primary directions exceed 0.50
real primary mean pair margin and strict direction exceed candidate-binding rotation on the same records
all identity/supergroup OOF, target-free, full-gallery-C128 and access validators pass

controls_and_claims.candidate_reorder: A permutation of candidate records must exactly permute scores. This is an invariance test, not the causal control.
controls_and_claims.candidate_binding: Rotate entire reference atlases across fixed candidate positions after training. This destroys reference-to-evidence binding while preserving count and capacity.
controls_and_claims.spatial: L0 intentionally contains no coordinates or proposal/hypothesis, so spatial permutation would be vacuous. Spatial destruction is pre-registered for L1 where fixed P-produced hypotheses introduce spatial structure.
controls_and_claims.comparison_boundary: L0 is the matched all-patch/no-hypothesis baseline. L1 must strictly beat L0 at equal head capacity before any hypothesis claim.
